title: Q-FLOW-RESUME-JOBS: bring the jobs, outreach and resume system under the flow map
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** weekly
**Done check:** file:doctrine/flows-external.json
**Status:** closed

The resume and job-search system (rwnq8.github.io, rwnq8.github.io/ultrastable, repository rwnq8/resume) is outside this repository's access. Declare its loops (ingest, answer bank, job-search state, surface audit) in a flows-external file with inflows, outflows and the returning signal (replies, interviews, page visits) that updates the resume and next applications; the flow check reads it. The Ultrastable funding outreach loop already returns replies to its registry and next run.

**Evidence:** closed by the pull request that carries this change
